note: 人工双语评审草稿，引用限p001-p350和本文件前段。回访候选不计实绩；音色待确认，实际口音时长待配音核验，无伪时间轴。

series.title: 云资源降本评审：节省不能吃掉安全余量
series.premise: 目录服务平均CPU偏低，财务提出缩规格与长期承诺采购。促销峰值、单区故障和未来迁移尚需验证。
series.outcome: 批准两个工作日的可回退规格试点，覆盖峰值与故障容量测试；暂不购买长期承诺。确认稳定基线、有效节省和合同退出限制后再审批有限覆盖。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 将工作节点调整到合适规格
扣除相关成本后的实际节省
稳定用量被承诺优惠覆盖的比例

recycling.note: 未来回访候选，未计作实际复现。

dialogues.title: 平均空闲是否就是浪费
dialogues.premise: 财务要求评审目录服务计算费用，尚未批准缩容。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出低利用率只是候选证据，不是缩容结论。

lines.en: Today we're reviewing catalog compute costs. We need options, not an emergency shutdown plan.
lines.zh: 今天评审目录计算费用。我们需要方案，不是紧急停机计划。

lines.en: Well, compute costs roughly thirty thousand monthly. Storage and transfer sit outside today's scope.
lines.zh: 嗯，计算每月约三万。存储和传输不在今天范围。

lines.en: Maybe we're overprovisioned on the worker tier. Average CPU stayed below twenty percent recently.
lines.zh: 工作节点可能配得过多。最近平均CPU低于百分之二十。

lines.en: Average CPU misses peaks and memory pressure. Show the distribution before recommending smaller machines.
lines.zh: 平均CPU漏掉峰值和内存压力。推荐小机器前先看分布。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is spare daytime capacity. The promotion runs overnight, so include that.
lines.zh: 当前假设是白天容量富余。促销在夜间运行，也要包含。

lines.en: Just to confirm, this is exploratory, right? Raj has bandwidth for a fuller comparison.
lines.zh: 确认一下，这是探索评审，对吧？Raj有空做完整对比。

lines.en: So, let's compare costs using consistent rates. Mixing list prices and discounts exaggerates savings.
lines.zh: 所以，用一致费率比较成本。混用标价和折扣会夸大节省。

lines.en: Okay, I'll pull two weeks of samples. I'll separate weekday demand from the promotion.
lines.zh: 好，我拉两周样本。区分工作日需求与促销。

lines.en: A fleet-wide reduction today? Let's park that. We'd lose the evidence needed for sizing.
lines.zh: 今天整组缩容？先放一边。那会失去配置所需证据。

lines.en: Just to recap, first compare demand and cost. Then choose a bounded test, not a quota.
lines.zh: 小结一下，先比较需求和成本。再选有边界的测试，不定硬指标。

dialogues.title: 促销样本推翻平均值
dialogues.premise: 收集两周按节点和时段划分的指标，补充夜间峰值。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分平均值、峰值与缺失样本。

lines.en: Okay, peak utilization hits sixty percent during promotions. Normal daytime demand is much lower than that.
lines.zh: 好，促销峰值利用率达百分之六十。正常白天需求远低于此。

lines.en: Are those peaks averaged across the fleet? One overloaded worker could disappear inside averages.
lines.zh: 峰值是整组平均吗？单个过载节点可能被平均值掩盖。

lines.en: They're per-worker peaks, with five-minute samples. Memory headroom stayed above thirty percent throughout.
lines.zh: 是每节点峰值，五分钟采样。全程内存余量超过百分之三十。

lines.en: Well, five-minute samples can miss bursts too. Include request latency and queue depth alongside.
lines.zh: 嗯，五分钟采样也会漏掉突发。还要结合请求延迟和队列深度。

lines.en: Maybe we're overprovisioned outside the sale itself. But demand could double during next month's campaign.
lines.zh: 可能仅促销之外配得过多。下月活动需求可能翻倍。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no missing peak samples, right? We'll keep an eye on forecast changes.
lines.zh: 确认一下，高峰样本没有缺失，对吧？我们会关注预测变化。

lines.en: One monitoring gap covers the previous sale. Don't present this as complete seasonal coverage.
lines.zh: 上次促销有一个监控空档。不能说已覆盖完整季节变化。

lines.en: Right, I can't rule that out yet. I'll label the gap and request archived metrics.
lines.zh: 对，现在还不能排除。我标注缺口并申请归档指标。

lines.en: So, test projected demand alongside historical loads. Historical spare capacity isn't a guarantee for growth.
lines.zh: 所以，除历史外也测试预计需求。历史富余不能保证增长后也够。

lines.en: Okay, I'll share the campaign forecast today. Treat the upper range as a test input.
lines.zh: 好，今天分享活动预测。把上限作为测试输入。

dialogues.title: 小规格先测内存和吞吐
dialogues.premise: 按节点指标显示缩规格有空间，但下月需求与规格限制需验证。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出缩规格不只减少CPU，还改变内存和网络能力。

lines.en: We could right-size the workers one tier. The smaller type halves available memory too.
lines.zh: 可以把节点调整小一档。较小规格也会将内存减半。

lines.en: Well, CPU alone won't justify that change. Check memory, network throughput, and sustained disk limits.
lines.zh: 嗯，CPU本身不能支持变更。检查内存、网络吞吐和持续磁盘限制。

lines.en: The campaign loads a larger catalog itself. Our cache could need more memory then.
lines.zh: 活动本身会加载更大目录。缓存可能需要更多内存。

lines.en: Price that exact type in our region. Smaller names don't guarantee proportional savings everywhere.
lines.zh: 按本区域该确切规格计价。规格名更小不保证各地同比例节省。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no live resizing today, right? First test the projected catalog and traffic.
lines.zh: 确认一下，今天不在线改规格，对吧？先测预计目录和流量。

lines.en: Peak utilization is our test baseline here. Maybe retain one tier more for memory.
lines.zh: 峰值利用率是测试基线。也许为内存保留更大一档。

lines.en: Define a rollback trigger before the pilot. Latency and failed work matter beyond CPU.
lines.zh: 试点前明确回退触发条件。除CPU外，延迟和任务失败也重要。

lines.en: Our smoke test checks fresh catalog reads. A load test must cover cache warm-up too.
lines.zh: 关键功能测试检查新目录读取。压测还必须覆盖缓存预热。

lines.en: So, count overlapping machines during the transition. That temporary cost belongs in the comparison.
lines.zh: 所以，还要算切换时同时运行的机器。临时费用也属于比较。

lines.en: Okay, Raj owns sizing and memory headroom. Anika supplies realistic datasets before the test starts.
lines.zh: 好，Raj负责规格和内存余量。Anika在开测前提供真实数据集。

dialogues.title: 折扣不等于免费退出
dialogues.premise: 采购提出一年承诺优惠，服务未来可能迁移。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分承诺消费、容量预留和实际可迁移范围。

lines.en: Well, committed spend could lower hourly rates. But we'd owe the minimum for one year.
lines.zh: 嗯，承诺消费可以降低小时费率。但一年都要付最低承诺额。

lines.en: Shouldn't we right-size the workers before buying? Otherwise we could commit to waste itself.
lines.zh: 不应先调好规格再买吗？否则可能把浪费本身承诺下来。

lines.en: Yes, and discounts don't necessarily reserve capacity. Check the specific product, not its marketing name.
lines.zh: 对，而且折扣不一定预留容量。看具体产品，不看宣传名。

lines.en: Just to confirm, discounts aren't capacity guarantees, right? We'll keep those two decisions separate today.
lines.zh: 确认一下，折扣不是容量保证，对吧？今天把两个决定分开。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis assumes catalog stays here. Maybe the migration changes that next quarter.
lines.zh: 当前假设是目录留在这里。下季度迁移可能改变这一点。

lines.en: So, this covers eligible compute in-region only. Another region or service may not qualify.
lines.zh: 所以，只覆盖本区域符合条件的计算。其他区域或服务可能不适用。

lines.en: Let me play that back for budgeting. Usage can fall while the minimum payment remains.
lines.zh: 我为预算复述一下。用量下降时最低付款仍在。

lines.en: Exactly, an unused commitment can erase savings. Check cancellation, exchange, and transfer rights explicitly.
lines.zh: 对，未用承诺会抵消节省。明确检查取消、交换和转让权利。

lines.en: A full-year fleet purchase? Let's park that. We need stable demand and contract review first.
lines.zh: 整组买一年？先放一边。先确认稳定需求并评审合同。

lines.en: I'll share the migration decision dates too. That should help bound any sensible commitment.
lines.zh: 我也分享迁移决策日期。这有助于限定合理承诺。

dialogues.title: 省钱不能依赖所有区域永远正常
dialogues.premise: 长期采购暂缓，继续评审缩规格后的峰值与故障承载能力。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出故障余量与常态利用率的不同。

lines.en: First, capacity headroom must cover zone loss. Normal peak utilization isn't the whole sizing requirement.
lines.zh: 先明确，容量余量必须覆盖可用区失效。正常峰值利用率不是全部要求。

lines.en: Right, smaller workers saturate in surviving zones. We might need more replicas during failover.
lines.zh: 对，小节点在剩余区会饱和。故障切换可能需要更多副本。

lines.en: Can the region supply those replicas quickly? A discount agreement won't answer that capacity question.
lines.zh: 区域能及时提供副本吗？折扣协议不能回答容量问题。

lines.en: The sale can't wait for cold starts. Maybe keep warm capacity through that peak.
lines.zh: 促销等不起冷启动。可以在高峰保留热容量。

lines.en: Just to confirm, test a zone loss, right? Memory headroom must stay healthy there too.
lines.zh: 确认一下，测试一个区失效，对吧？那时内存余量也要正常。

lines.en: Yes, model it safely in the sandbox. Don't create a live outage for cost evidence.
lines.zh: 对，在沙箱安全模拟。不要为成本证据制造线上故障。

lines.en: We can't rule that out as a bottleneck. I'll test startup time and quota limits.
lines.zh: 还不能排除这是瓶颈。我测试启动时间和配额限制。

lines.en: So, committed spend covers only steady demand. Temporary peak capacity needs a separate cost model.
lines.zh: 所以，承诺消费只覆盖稳定需求。临时峰值容量需要独立成本模型。

lines.en: I'll provide the peak customer journey itself. Queue recovery time matters after the demand drops.
lines.zh: 我提供高峰客户流程本身。需求下降后的队列恢复时间也重要。

lines.en: Okay, failed headroom means no broad reduction. We can still pursue scheduling waste separately.
lines.zh: 好，余量不达标就不全面缩减。仍可单独解决调度浪费。

dialogues.title: 两个工作日的小范围试点
dialogues.premise: 方案加入安全余量，计划先在沙箱再在小流量节点试点。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住试点范围、时长、停止条件和证据。

lines.en: Okay, the cost pilot starts in staging tomorrow. We'll right-size the workers in one test pool.
lines.zh: 好，降本试点明天从预发布开始。只调整一个测试池节点规格。

lines.en: First, pass peak and zone-loss tests. The live pool gets a small traffic share.
lines.zh: 先通过峰值和区域失效测试。线上池只接小部分流量。

lines.en: Okay, a staged rollout over two weekdays. Each expansion waits for its own validation.
lines.zh: 好，在两个工作日内分阶段发布。每次扩大都等独立验证。

lines.en: The rollback trigger includes customer latency itself. If reads slow beyond target, stop expanding.
lines.zh: 回退触发条件包含客户延迟本身。读取慢于目标就停止扩大。

lines.en: Well, keep a matched control pool too. Otherwise demand changes could masquerade as savings.
lines.zh: 嗯，也保留匹配的对照池。否则需求变化可能被误认为节省。

lines.en: Right, capacity headroom stays in acceptance checks. Maybe smaller CPU with unchanged memory works better.
lines.zh: 对，容量余量仍纳入验收。可能CPU较小但内存不变更合适。

lines.en: Don't change runtime tuning at the same time. We'd lose attribution for any performance difference.
lines.zh: 不要同时改运行参数。否则性能变化难归因。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on the approvals. Raj records machine type, traffic share, and rates.
lines.zh: 我关注审批。Raj记录机型、流量份额和费率。

lines.en: So, report overlap and engineering hours too. The pilot's total cost matters for repeatability.
lines.zh: 所以，也报告重叠运行和工程工时。试点总成本关系到是否可重复。

lines.en: I'll reserve a reviewer for both days. That keeps decisions inside normal working hours.
lines.zh: 我为两天安排评审者。确保决策在正常工作时间内完成。

dialogues.title: 折扣截止不应替代风险评审
dialogues.premise: 试点安排明确，但采购报价期限引发是否立即签约的争议。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出不同角色如何提出异议并澄清合同风险。

lines.en: Well, exit terms don't allow early cancellation. Exchanges are limited, and refunds aren't promised.
lines.zh: 嗯，退出条款不允许提前取消。交换有限，也不保证退款。

lines.en: Then the deadline isn't a reason itself. I won't lock next year's migration budget blindly.
lines.zh: 那截止日期本身不是理由。我不会盲目锁定明年迁移预算。

lines.en: Committed spend also uses today's oversized baseline. Maybe the pilot reduces eligible demand significantly.
lines.zh: 承诺消费还基于今天过大的配置。试点可能明显降低适用需求。

lines.en: I agree, but avoid assuming every reduction lasts. Model stable, growing, and migrating demand separately.
lines.zh: 同意，但别假定缩减永久持续。分别建模稳定、增长和迁移需求。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no purchase approval today, right? The cost pilot remains approved and funded.
lines.zh: 确认一下，今天不批准采购，对吧？降本试点仍获批并有资金。

lines.en: Correct, the offer can expire without purchase. Procurement may request another quote after validation.
lines.zh: 对，可以让报价到期不买。验证后采购可以再询价。

lines.en: What about the promised quarterly saving target? Let's park that exact number until evidence arrives.
lines.zh: 已承诺的季度节省目标怎么办？等证据再确定精确数字。

lines.en: So, give finance a range with risks. A forced target can encourage unsafe resource cuts.
lines.zh: 所以，给财务带风险说明的区间。强制目标会诱导不安全资源缩减。

lines.en: We can take it offline with procurement. I'll bring the demand model, not just prices.
lines.zh: 我们可以会后与采购单聊。我带需求模型，不只带价格。

lines.en: Okay, keep the decision in our notes. Deferred purchasing isn't a rejected savings effort.
lines.zh: 好，把决定记下来。暂缓采购不代表拒绝降本。

dialogues.title: 节省要扣掉转移成本
dialogues.premise: 采购暂缓，团队确定试点的成本和可靠性验收标准。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别实际节省与仅单价下降。

lines.en: First, effective savings means total costs fall. Include overlap, extra replicas, and engineering effort.
lines.zh: 先明确，实际节省意味着总成本下降。包含重叠运行、额外副本和工程投入。

lines.en: Right, our cost pilot compares equal work. A cheaper hour could process fewer useful requests.
lines.zh: 对，试点对比等量完成工作。更便宜的一小时可能处理更少有效请求。

lines.en: Add latency and error-rate gates alongside cost. Cost per request mustn't hide customer harm.
lines.zh: 成本之外增加延迟和错误率门槛。每请求成本不能掩盖客户损害。

lines.en: Just to confirm, equal workload and rates, right? Peak utilization gets reported for each pool.
lines.zh: 确认一下，工作量和费率一致，对吧？每个池报告峰值利用率。

lines.en: The smoke test is only the entry check. It can't replace the full load run.
lines.zh: 关键功能测试只是入门检查，不能替代完整带载测试。

lines.en: Well, use observations plus clearly labelled estimates. Two days won't produce a settled monthly bill.
lines.zh: 嗯，使用观测结果和明确标注的估算。两天不会产生结算月账单。

lines.en: Maybe compare normalized daily totals first instead. We'll keep workload variance visible in the report.
lines.zh: 可以先比较归一化日总额。报告里保留工作量变化。

lines.en: So, show simulated zone-loss results separately too. Averages shouldn't erase that critical failure case.
lines.zh: 所以，模拟区域失效结果也单独显示。平均值不能抹掉关键失效情形。

lines.en: Just to recap, savings and safety both pass. Either failed gate blocks a broader rollout.
lines.zh: 小结一下，节省和安全都要通过。任一失败就阻止扩大。

lines.en: I'll sign the customer-impact check after review. No acceptance based on price charts alone.
lines.zh: 评审后我签客户影响检查。不能仅凭价格图验收。

dialogues.title: 试点获批，长期承诺未批
dialogues.premise: 验收标准已明确，评审会落实试点与后续采购责任。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出今天正式批准什么、明确未批准什么。

lines.en: We approve the bounded sizing test today. Commitment coverage stays undecided until demand is stable.
lines.zh: 今天批准有边界的规格测试。需求稳定前不决定承诺覆盖比例。

lines.en: Right, committed spend covers a conservative baseline. Don't purchase against the campaign's temporary peak.
lines.zh: 对，承诺消费覆盖保守基线。不要按活动临时峰值采购。

lines.en: First action item, I own test execution. I'll attach workload, resource limits, and rollback evidence.
lines.zh: 第一项待办，我负责执行测试。附工作量、资源限制和回退证据。

lines.en: Good, I'll review reliability gates on Thursday. Failed tests mean revise, not quietly lower thresholds.
lines.zh: 好，我周四评审可靠性门槛。测试失败就修改方案，不悄悄降低阈值。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for exit terms? We need legal review before any signature.
lines.zh: 退出条款谁来接？签字前需要法务评审。

lines.en: I'll coordinate procurement and the legal reviewer. Maybe Friday for the first written assessment.
lines.zh: 我协调采购与法务评审者。首份书面评估可能周五。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no contract signature yet, right? Each purchase needs its own budget approval.
lines.zh: 确认一下，仍不签合同，对吧？每次采购要独立预算批准。

lines.en: I'll price a low baseline option too. The unused commitment risk should be explicit.
lines.zh: 我也为低基线方案计价。未用承诺风险要明确。

lines.en: So, keep migration flexibility in that comparison. Cheap steady-state pricing isn't the only strategic consideration.
lines.zh: 所以，比较里保留迁移灵活性。稳态低价不是唯一战略考虑。

lines.en: Okay, I'll own the demand forecast itself. We'll update it before the purchase discussion.
lines.zh: 好，我负责需求预测本身。采购讨论前更新。

dialogues.title: 下一轮看证据，不追漂亮百分比
dialogues.premise: 试点排期与负责人确定，约定后续验证和采购复审。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住复查条件与不能提前宣称的成果。

lines.en: Okay, we'll revisit the sizing next Monday. Bring measured results and any incomplete checks.
lines.zh: 好，下周一重新审视规格。带测量结果及未完成检查。

lines.en: I'll close the loop on the pilot. Maybe the best choice keeps more memory.
lines.zh: 我完成试点闭环。最佳方案可能保留更多内存。

lines.en: Well, show effective savings as a range. Actual billing reconciliation follows when charges are posted.
lines.zh: 嗯，实际节省先显示为区间。费用入账后再做账单核对。

lines.en: Can we circle back after campaign planning? The new forecast could change commitment coverage itself.
lines.zh: 活动规划后可以再讨论吗？新预测可能改变承诺覆盖比例本身。

lines.en: Yes, don't buy before that uncertainty clears. If it persists, retain flexible pricing for now.
lines.zh: 可以，不确定性消除前别买。如果持续，就暂留灵活计价。

lines.en: Just to recap, test approved, purchase deferred. No promised percentage until both gates pass.
lines.zh: 小结一下，测试获批，采购暂缓。两个门槛通过前不承诺百分比。

lines.en: Procurement will return the actual contract restrictions. We'll compare those against migration timing again.
lines.zh: 采购会反馈实际合同限制。我们再与迁移时间比较。

lines.en: I'll preserve the baseline and test datasets. Future reviews need reproducible comparisons, not remembered impressions.
lines.zh: 我保留基线和测试数据集。未来评审要可重现对比，不凭印象。

lines.en: So, review again if demand changes materially. A passing pilot doesn't guarantee every future peak.
lines.zh: 所以，需求明显变化就再次评审。试点通过不保证未来每次峰值。

lines.en: Okay, we'll keep customers ahead of targets. Savings count only when the service stays useful.
lines.zh: 好，客户优先于指标。服务仍有用时节省才算数。
